notes: No app source, entitlements, Info.plist or scheme files were edited.
All five outer captures were complete and visually checked before attempts to switch to the inner display.

The workspace interaction session was reported missing after its successful install/run, so capture continued with a standalone device session. Standalone applicationState=NotRun did not indicate app failure; actual app UI and process were present and verified.

An observed app navigation issue occurred during bookmark setup: navigating to Romans 10:9 by sword URL and the reference picker updated the title but retained a viewport around verses 17 onward. Manual scrolling reached verse 9; the saved bookmark was verified as Romans 10:9. This did not affect the final source scenes.

After completing the outer set, simctl screenConfig powered screen 1 off and screen 3 on, but the inner display stayed black. Device Hub Open/Closed hinge controls and restoration of screen 1 power did not recover it. A reboot of capture simulator 663A529E-D1E2-4BD8-889E-694DDDB9F986 was attempted before user reported repeated SpringBoard crashes. Further capture and display-switch attempts then stopped.

Read-only inspection found 12 SpringBoard reports with capture times between 14:18:02 and 14:20:22 +1100. All reports identify capture simulator 663A529E-D1E2-4BD8-889E-694DDDB9F986 in coalitionName. Repeated SIGABRT reports involve SBMainDisplayConfigurationTransformer transformDisplayConfiguration; SIGTRAP reports involve FBSDisplayMode initialization during classic-mode display-configuration processing. This establishes display-configuration failure context, not a proven app-source defect.

Device Hub temporarily showed the other pre-existing simulator after an external UI change; its identifier was rechecked and the capture simulator was reselected before further deliberate hinge actions. No app or data changes were deliberately made on the pre-existing simulator.

cleanup.status: Capture simulator shut down to stop the crash loop; original Xcode run destination restored. No inner-display retries performed.
